<description>
Currently, rpc code may return the wrong `RPCErrorCode`. This is perfectly fine, because they should be hit rarely in production.

However, it could be good to be self-consistent. (Otherwise, we could just remove the different error codes and return a single one)

So fix a few error codes:

* An integral out-of-range is now `RPC_TYPE_ERROR`, not `RPC_MISC_ERROR`
* Some invalid args are now `RPC_INVALID_PARAMETER`
* Some transient issues or user-config issues are now `RPC_MISC_ERROR`
* Finally, `RPC_INTERNAL_ERROR` is reserved for internal bugs or internal corruption
</description>

<commits>
faf981a272 rpc: For int out-of-range, throw RPC_TYPE_ERROR (-3), not RPC_MISC_ERROR (-1)

This follows the other json type errors from commit
55566630c60d23993a52ed54c95e7891f4588d57.

fa598e9b39 doc: Use proper doxygen groups for RPCErrorCode

Previously, the group comment was incorrectly attached to the first item
in the group.

fad9b5066e rpc: Use RPC_INVALID_PARAMETER for invalid args

This follows all other uses of the constant, like:

throw JSONRPCError(RPC_INVALID_PARAMETER, "The PSBT version can only be 2 or 0");

fa17d12195 rpc: Use RPC_INTERNAL_ERROR for unreachable internal error only

Also, switch the two violations to use RPC_MISC_ERROR (-1):

* coinstatsindex still syncing
* disabled fee estimation

This follows other intermittent or user-config errors, such as:

* throw JSONRPCError(RPC_MISC_ERROR, "The mempool was not loaded yet");
* throw JSONRPCError(RPC_MISC_ERROR, "Can't rescan beyond pruned data...");

eeeeb4cf64 rpc: refactor: Use explicit RPC_MISC_ERROR

This refactor does not change any behavior because a runtime_error
exception is currently mapped to RPC_MISC_ERROR.

Though, using explicit RPC_MISC_ERROR is clearer and follows other
intermittent or user-config errors.

fa9afca584 rpc: refactor: Explicitly throw rpc help as RPC_MISC_ERROR (-1)

This refactor does not change any behavior.

fa9696eaff rpc: refactor: Throw RPC_MISC_ERROR explicitly on external signer errors

This refactor does not change any behavior because a runtime_error
exception is currently mapped to RPC_MISC_ERROR.

Though, using explicit RPC_MISC_ERROR is clearer and follows other
intermittent or user-config errors.

fa6e112c1a rpc: Use RPC_INTERNAL_ERROR for internal errors

Internal errors or bugs should never happen, so this should not change
any production behavior. Though, using RPC_INTERNAL_ERROR is more
consistent.
</commits>
